newsitem.title: HONG KONG: China North Star plans $100-$150 mln H share IPO.
newsitem.headline: China North Star plans $100-$150 mln H share IPO.

text.p: Property concern Beijing North Star Industrial Group Co Ltd said on Tuesday it planned to raise US$100-150 million with an initial public offer of H shares.

North Star expects to offer and list the H shares -- equity issued by mainland Chinese firms for listing in Hong Kong -- by June 30 this year, a company official told the China Securities Bulletin, a Hong Kong-based newsletter.
North Star is among 38 enterprises approved by the Securities Commission of the State Council at the end of 1996 to list shares abroad, the official said.
The exact issuing time and price have not yet been fixed and the company is choosing underwriters, he said.
The firm's income comes mainly from property rental, including offices and residential buildings as well as a four-star hotel located at the Asian Athletic Village in Beijing, the official said.
The company is also engaged in constructing a new residential complex in Beijing, he said, adding that the project will become a key source of profits in the future.
"North Star, which forecasts a bright future for the urban property market, has vast land reserves for use over the next 10 years," the company official said.
